about: Rugby League > Jersey (rugby-jersey-textured.glb, RUGBYJ 2026-11-18): coloured from the same garment split into parts by Tripo (rugby-jersey-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: the body the print (yellow Main); the sleeves, inside and out, the Left / Right sleeve parts (navy), each sleeve's raglan seam one smooth line; the stand-up collar the Collar colour (yellow), its foot one smooth line round the neck; an even band inside the collar just under its top fold the Accent (navy, the client's picture 592). Stitch lines (the user 2026-11-18, pictures 592/600/601): the neck seam 9 mm below the collar's foot, the collar's edge 7 mm below its top, a cuff line 17 mm above each sleeve opening and a hem line 17 mm above the bottom, drawn by main.js as thin darker strips. The band is the design part 'collarBand' (else the Accent), one plain colour also under a design picture; data narrowEdge: the edge light only at the outline. flatSmoothY: the body's print places across measured round a smoothed section (straight back numbers over the cloth's folds).
